gloss: visiting someone who is ill; get-well visit

definitions.explanation: The act of visiting and expressing concern for someone who is sick or hospitalized.
A gift brought when visiting someone who is ill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{見舞|みま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to visit someone at the hospital.

examples.japanese: お{見舞|みま}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていった→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I brought flowers as a get-well gift.

examples.english: I delivered flowers and fruit as a get-well gift to my hospitalized friend.

notes:
お{見舞|みま}い refers to visiting someone who is ill or has experienced misfortune.

Formation: ⟦お〜→お〜：03097_o⟧ (honorific) + ⟦{見舞|みま}う→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧ (to visit/inquire after)

Types:
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧{見舞|みま}い: visiting someone who is sick
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧{見舞|みま}い: visiting after a disaster

Common gifts for お{見舞|みま}い:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: flowers (avoid certain types - no potted plants as they suggest 'rooted' illness)
- ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧: fruit
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: money (in envelope marked お{見舞|みま}い)
